meta.title: MiLabs: focused software for work and money
meta.description: MiLabs makes the Mi family of products: MiDesk for running the operations of a business, and MiFin for personal and shared finances. Each one is built around a single job.
meta.ogAlt: MiLabs: software that brings order to work and money.

hero.title: Software that brings order to *work* and *money*.
hero.lead: MiLabs makes the Mi products, each built around one job. MiDesk runs the day-to-day operations of a business. MiFin keeps personal and shared expenses clear.

products.title: Two products. Each with *one job*.
products.intro: Every Mi product has its own website, where you will find the details. Here is what each one is for.
products.provisional: Illustrative interface, not a product screenshot

ecosystem.title: One prefix. Separate products. *A shared standard.*
ecosystem.p1: MiDesk and MiFin are independent products, each with its own website. You can use one without the other.
ecosystem.p2: What they share is the way they are made: a narrow focus, screens that explain themselves, and the habit of improving after launch. The Mi in each name stands for that standard.

focus.title: One job, done properly.
focus.text: Every Mi product starts from a specific problem, and its name says what it is for. If a feature does not serve that job, it waits.

clarity.title: Clarity before cleverness.
clarity.text: Screens should explain themselves. We would rather remove a step than add a tooltip to explain it.

time.title: Respect for your time.
time.text: Fewer screens, fewer surprises. Software should take minutes out of your week, not hours.

improve.title: Shipped, then improved.
improve.text: A product is not finished at launch. We keep refining it based on how people actually use it.

closing.title: Start with the one you *need today*.
closing.note: Product websites open in a new tab.

footer.tagline: Focused software for work and money.
